caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular lantern with a wooden frame and four turned wooden vertical supports at each corner. The sides and top panels of the lantern appear to be made of a translucent, light gray material with a pattern of evenly spaced small, circular holes arranged in concentric circles and radiating lines. The front panel has a hinged door with a small latch. A thin, curved metal handle is attached to the top of the lantern on both ends. The overall composition is centered on a plain background with a faint border, and the drawing uses muted brown, gray, and black colors for the lantern and its components.
title: Foot Warmer
